verdicts.proof: Old: product_detail_screen.dart:54 resets cartFabDismissedProvider (4.1.3 had it at :200). The same _addToCart handler serves both looks (v2 branch only changes the toast, :55-61). v2 cart strip uses the same condition in shell_fab_layer.dart:264 (_v2Strips: cartCount>0 && !onShopFlow && !onPaymentScreen && !dismissed). voucher_screen.dart:54 adds to cart without the reset in both looks (not a v2 difference).

Old cart_screen.dart:87-106 empty branch has no checkout button. v2 cart_view_v2.dart:69-88 empty branch: MgStateBanner with cartEmpty heading and a to-shop button, no dock/CTA. Only other route to /checkout is router.dart:468 (deep link) and _finalize still refuses an empty cart (shop_checkout_screen.dart:422-428) for both looks.

Old cart_screen.dart:76-84 (only when non-empty). v2 onClear = same notifier.clear()+toast (cart_screen.dart:47), button cart_view_v2.dart:93 exists only in non-empty branch; now red with trash icon (more visible).

shop_provider.dart:47-53 changeQty removes at <=0. v2 QtyStepperV2 onMinus (cart_view_v2.dart:167) -> onMinus -> notifier.changeQty(id,-1) (cart_screen.dart:45). Same behaviour, same (silent) communication as old.
digitalOnly/shipping computed once in cart_screen.dart:28-31 and passed to v2 (:39-43); v2 hides the row with the same if (!digitalOnly) at cart_view_v2.dart:104.
Old cart_screen.dart:165-169 shopPriceNote; v2 cart_view_v2.dart:115 same key under the total.

_finalize starts with if (_processing) return (shop_checkout_screen.dart:415). v2 CTA: busy: processing, onTap null while processing (checkout_view_v2.dart:110-111); MgCta disables tap when busy (mg_cta.dart:212-217). Only pay entry in v2 is that CTA (onPay: _finalize, shop_checkout_screen.dart:729); error-sheet retries also call _finalize and hit the same guard.

BackButtonListener + PopScope(canPop: !_processing) at shop_checkout_screen.dart:680-694 wrap the MgV2.on ternary, so both looks share them; v2 app-bar back = onBack: _onBack (:730, checkout_view_v2.dart:93) -> confirmLeaveRunningPayment and _goPending (:652-666). Bottom tab bar in AppShell is shared and identical in both looks (app_shell.dart:104, no v2 branch), so no extra v2 exit. 4.1.3 had no such lock.
Same BackButtonListener (!canPop -> _onBack -> backOr(Routes.cart), :684-686, :665) wraps v2; v2 app-bar arrow calls the same _onBack.
_signature (:316-321) and reuse when _orderSig==sig (:470-473) are inside _finalize, the only pay handler for v2 (onPay: _finalize, :729). Silent in both looks (new on this branch; not in 4.1.3).
